key_insight: VerifiedLab turns research records into machine-usable evidence, enabling AI agents to assess claims against field-level verification and data reliability.
engineering_relevance: For perovskite solar-cell research, the framework supports evidence-grounded analysis and prediction while withholding claims that fail its checks.
method: A principal-investigator agent plans research, and a librarian computes evidence directly from verified records.
Specialist agents draft findings; gate and critic agents check claims against measured data reliability.
The harness decides whether to release or withhold findings.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive perovskite solar-cell experiments that recover known physical trends and anticipate devices reported a year later, but provides no quantitative metrics.
watch_item: Practical reliability depends on the quality and coverage of field-level verification; the abstract does not quantify verification cost or predictive accuracy.
